LightningComponentBundle.description: Review and sign a Portwood signature request inside a Screen Flow, in the same tab, then continue the Flow once the signature is recorded. For signed-in users only; guests are refused.

property.name: signerUrl
property.label: Signer URL
property.description: The signing link from the Create Signature Request action (one entry of Signer URLs). The signer token is read from it.

property.name: signerUrls
property.label: Signer URLs (collection)
property.description: Alternative to Signer URL: the whole Signer URLs collection from Create Signature Request. The first entry is used, so use this only for a single-signer request.

property.name: token
property.label: Signer token
property.description: Alternative to Signer URL: the 64-character signer token itself.

property.name: waitForNext
property.label: Wait for the user to select Next after signing
property.description: Off (default): the Flow moves to the next screen as soon as the server has recorded the signature. On: the signer selects Next themselves. Next is blocked until signing is recorded either way.

property.name: signed
property.label: Signed
property.description: True once this signer's signature is recorded.

property.name: declined
property.label: Declined
property.description: True if the signer declined the request. The Flow continues so you can branch on this.

property.name: requestComplete
property.label: Request complete
property.description: True when every signer on the request has signed.

property.name: errorMessage
property.label: Error message
property.description: Why signing could not proceed, if it could not.
